title: Check the length before handover; cut what the story can lose.
text: Check the long form's length before handover: over 20 min, cut the pieces least worth it in the story (asides, a point told twice, feelings that move nothing) until it is in 17-20 min. On 20261126 I handed over v1 at 23.2 min, and the user said: "check the length again. It's above 20 minutes. So cut something that you think is not worth in the story".
confirm: How long is the body, and which pieces were cut to bring it into 17-20 min (source timecodes, why each)?
